Late Nights. Voxel Worlds.

Pixel Pact is a passion project born in the depths of late-night gaming sessions. We are four friends who love to build, code, design, and break things together.

From surviving our first night in a dirt hut to constructing massive automated redstone networks, our journey has been fueled by friendship, creativity, and a healthy dose of friendly fire.
